claim: Under ordinary funded growth with either declared knot law, in the two-frame marked receiving class with a fixed return and input ports, the particular size-m release first enters a true receiving member at size 2m+2ℓ+9, where ℓ is the shortest allowed passage between the ports. Its continuing internal chain has floor(N/24) turns from origin. In five physically matched starts at m=32, the first inclusive birth is at size 65; strict receipt takes four further turns after sending on a 34-meeting passage and five on a 46-meeting passage. Replacing the lasting third by a finite passage of the same shortest length leaves all registered times unchanged in this class, including after the designated finite third has disappeared.
epistemic_class: Mathematical theorem in the specified ordinary-growth class. The frozen numerical experiment is an exploratory replay.
limits: Prepared marked roles, fixed clock and ports, ordinary connected-set true-parent identification, sufficient funding and full-history receiving reader. A finite passage reproduces the persistent third’s timing. No general activity-specific, population-frequency or gravitational clock-rate inference. Independent scientific referee pending.
